title: Practice 1: вз- (вс-): up — на-: onto, and a quantity covered

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Look! The airplane is taking off.
exercises.why: Temporal and resultative prefixes, from the same table: по- — Beginning of unidirectional movement, with unidirectional verb of motion: Я пошла в университет. — I went to the university. Other: 1. Intention to carry out a movement in the future: Зимой я собираюсь поехать во Флориду. — In the winter I plan to go to Florida. 2. Approximate location of the agent at moment of speech: Где папа? Он пошёл на работу. — Where's Dad? He went to (is at) work. по- — Slow and measured multidirectional movement, with multidirectional verb of motion: Она задумчиво походила по квартире и наконец решила уйти. — She walked around the apartment pensively and finally decided to leave. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: У неё ___ (набежать / набегать) слёзы на глаза.
